body:
"Leftists tend to hate anything that has an image of being strong, good and
successful. They hate America, they hate Western civilization, they hate
white males, they hate rationality. The reasons that leftists give for
hating the West, etc. clearly do not correspond with their real motives.
They SAY they hate the West because it is warlike, imperialistic, sexist,
ethnocentric and so forth, but where these same faults appear in socialist
countries or in primitive cultures, the leftist finds excuses for them, or
at best he GRUDGINGLY admits that they exist; whereas he ENTHUSIASTICALLY
points out (and often greatly exaggerates) these faults where they appear in
Western civilization. Thus it is clear that these faults are not the
leftist's real motive for hating America and the West. He hates America and
the West because they are strong and successful." (Paragraph 15)

As you can see from above, Ted Kaczynski is no self-hating,
platitude-quoting, tree-hugging, feminist-toting, animal rights-advocating,
moron.  He is clearly a right-winger.  Does the fact that he is critical of
technology make him a leftist?  Hell no.  He is just an open-minded person
who doesn't care for partisanship.

What I really like about Ted Kaczynski is that not only did he stand up for
mankind in general, but he especially stood up for whites and Western
civilization.  Every day white people, through the mass media and the
educational institutions especially, are bombarded with lies and half-truths
and are taught to hate themselves.

The reality is, whites are the ONLY race in the world who care for the
well-being of other races.  Whites try to make AMENDS for the past
injustices they have taken part in, as well as publicly censure themselves
for them on a daily basis.  What other race in the world does this?  Yes,
whites killed and enslaved a lot of people in earlier times, but the reason
for this was because whites had the superior technology and organization.
Whites were simply able to conquer BEFORE being conquered.  Do you really
believe if Native Americans or sub-Saharan Africans had the means to conquer
Europeans that they would not have tried to because their nature was more
noble than the whites?  Give me a break.  They would have been the FIRST to
rape and pillage white villages if they had the chance.

That's what leftists don't understand: This world is not a nice place.  The
strong survive and the weak get conquered.  Is that morally right?  No.
It's just LIFE.

So please, enough of the whining, the victimization, the self-pity... ugh!
I'm sick of it.
